# Affordance

> A browser for models. Apps are TSX views of state; Affordance renders them into the exact token ids a model reads, exposes the actions still visible after layout as its tools, and runs many agents with journals that replay exactly. Rust library and one command, `affordance` (`run` a deployment in `affordance.yaml`, `serve` it over HTTP, `host` it for a frontend over stdio, `init`, `render`, `test`, `lint`).

An app renders its state; the model's reply names a visible action (`<aff>`); its handler changes the state; the next render follows. The app owns its loop, tools and context policy. The runtime owns rendering, layout under a token budget, effects (model calls, machine commands, timers, messages), journals and recovery.

## Start

- [README](README.md): what it is, a complete app, the first commands
- [Getting started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): install the command, render an app, write and run a first agent
- [A first agent](examples/first_agent/README.md): a complete agent against a local or hosted model, with a shell
